title: Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Single-cell transcriptome measurements can reveal unexplored biological diversity, but they suffer from technical noise and bias that must be modeled to account for the resulting uncertainty in downstream analyses.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Here we introduce single-cell variational inference (scVI), a ready-to-use scalable framework for the probabilistic representation and analysis of gene expression in single cells ( https://github.com/YosefLab/scVI ). scVI uses stochastic optimization and deep neural networks to aggregate information across similar cells and genes and to approximate the distributions that underlie observed expression values, while accounting for batch effects and limited sensitivity.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】We used scVI for a range of fundamental analysis tasks including batch correction, visualization, clustering, and differential expression, and achieved high accuracy for each task.

We used scVI for a range of fundamental analysis tasks including batch correction, visualization, clustering, and differential expression, and achieved high accuracy for each task.
